messages.subject: Project Onyx - signed term sheet
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Eleanor,

Please find attached the term sheet for Project Onyx, signed by Verdant, reflecting our discussion on the cost-cap mechanics (payable on completion). We look forward to the DD request list and to progressing to long-form. We'll circulate a first draft of the subscription and shareholders' agreement next week.

Kind regards,
Sarah Whitfield
Partner, Whitfield Carter LLP

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | www.whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
